tower.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

tower.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

tower.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.Capacity.description: Capacity is the target's room, as quantities.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.Counts.description: Counts are the target's objects as tower holds them.

instances.description: Instances by phase, such as RUNNING: 4.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.Fact.description: Fact is one thing a provider reports about itself.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.HangarTarget.description: HangarTarget is one project of a hangar endpoint, which tower uses as an ordinary client.

credentialSecret.description: A Secret in tower's reserved project "system" holding the hangar service token tower calls the endpoint with, under the key "token".

project.description: The hangar project every environment of this target lives in.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.HostdTarget.description: HostdTarget is a host running hostd. The host is whoever holds a ROLE_HOSTD token whose target is this one.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.TargetSettings.description: TargetSettings are the knobs of tower's policy on this target. Each unset one takes tower's default.

idleStopAfter.description: A box unused for this long is stopped (its disk kept) until it is used again. Zero is tower's default; a box workstream keeps, or that runs background work, is never stopped for idleness.

warmBudget.description: How much disk warm goldens may hold on this target, as a quantity such as 200Gi. The most used repositories get one first.

warmMaxAge.description: A warm golden whose checkout is older than this, or more commits behind its branch than warm_max_commits_behind, is rebuilt.

warmWindow.description: How far back a repository's use counts toward its rank.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.TargetSpec.description: TargetSpec is what the target is, and the settings tower's policy reads for it.

hangar.description: Set at most one of hangar, hostd.

hostd.description: Set at most one of hangar, hostd.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.TargetStatus.description: TargetStatus is the target's state as its provider last reported it and as tower counts it: enough to see what is wrong without logging in to it.

conditions.description: Reachable: tower can call the provider. Reporting: the provider reported within its interval, which tower turns false after three intervals of silence. DiskPressure: free disk is under the warm budget plus a fixed margin (20Gi) for the instances to grow into.

facts.description: What the provider says about itself, one fact a line: its version, the health of its ZFS pool, its Docker and QEMU versions, a hangar project's quota and what it uses of it.

lastError.description: The last error calling or hearing from the provider, if it has not succeeded since.

tower.targets.v1alpha1.Usage.description: Usage is what holds the target's disk, by what it is for.

instances.description: What instances hold beyond the goldens they were cloned from.

other.description: Everything else the provider counts on its disk.

description: Target is a place environments run: one project of a hangar endpoint, or one host running hostd. An administrator registers it; Placement says which projects run on it. See docs/decisions/placement.md.
title: Target
